name: verify-cli
description: Drive the `everr` CLI and its local stack (embedded collector, chDB, local browser UI) the way a user does, in an isolated throwaway instance, and capture proof. Use when a change touches `packages/cli`, the collector packages it builds in (`collector/localcollector`, `collector/internal/localgateway`, `collector/exporter/chdbexporter`), `packages/local-app` or `packages/telemetry-explorer`, or when you must prove `everr local start/status/stop/query`, `everr wrap`, `everr skills`, or the local Logs UI actually work.

findings.excerpt: V="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.agents/skills/verify-cli/scripts/verify-cli.ts"
1. Toolchain (once per machine). The build needs: Node >= 24 (repo pins `.node-version` = 24; Node 20 cannot run the `.ts` build scripts), pnpm via corepack (ve
$V build      # cold: dominated by the chDB download and compression; warm: much faster
$V launch            # or: $V launch <RUN_ID>
$V doctor
$V cli <label> -- <everr args...>
$V cli-until <label> '<expected stdout text>' -- local query "<SQL>" --format ndjson
$V ui-get /health
eval "$($V browser-env)"       # AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=verify-everr-<RUN_ID>, UI, SHOTS=<evidence>/ui, ab_save
$V cleanup
- **Health.** Run `$V ui-get /health`. JSON has `"service":"everr-local-ui"` and the same `instance_id` as `curl -s $EVERR_SQL_HTTP_ORIGIN/health` (both checked
- **API guard.** Run `eval "$($V env)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H "Host: ${EVERR_LOCAL_UI_ORIGIN#http://}" -H 'Content-Type: application
- **Run wrapped command.** Run `$V cli wrap-run -- wrap sh -c "echo $M-out; echo $M-err >&2; exit 3"`. Stdout is `$M-out`, stderr is `$M-err`, exit code is `3`
- Service name is derived from the program, not the full command: `sh -c ...` is `everr-wrap-sh`, `pnpm test` is `everr-wrap-pnpm`. Always also filter by marker
